chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 95: Li Huowang’s Mother Kneels—The Breaking Point
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang chases Layue Shiba into a kindergarten, but when his mother kneels before the police, his certainty collapses. “I can’t tell them apart anymore!”
og_description: A mother’s desperation and a son’s confession—Chapter 95 is the chapter where the line between “real” and “illusion” finally bleeds into one unbearable cry.
twitter_title: Ch. 95: Li Huowang screams “I can’t tell!”—and you’ll feel it
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s mother kneels in front of the police. He holds a child hostage. Then he breaks. This chapter is pure, unfiltered anguish.
